If A = 0, then A+ A · B = 0 + 1 · B = B. Therefore, A+ A · B= A+ B. out = (A+ B) · ( D + C · C) · ( C · ( C + D)) C· C=O,so out =(A+B)·(D+O)·(C·(C+D)) =(A+B)·D·(C·(C+D)) The last product, C · ( C + D ), is equal to 1 when C = 1 and is equal to O when C = 0, regardless of the value of D, so out= (A+B)·D· C The output is 1 only when C = 1, D = 0, and either A = 1 or B = 1; the output is O under all other conditions. Commutative does not involve Expansion or Grouping Shift.

theory_html:
1. Number Systems & Codes

Base Conversions: Binary (Base 2), Octal (Base 8, groups of 3 bits), Hexadecimal (Base 16, groups of 4 bits).

Signed Numbers (2's Complement): To find the negative, invert all bits and add 1 to the LSB. MSB is the sign bit (0 = pos, 1 = neg).

2. Boolean Algebra

Identity: A + 0 = A, A · 1 = A

Null (Dominance): A + 1 = 1, A · 0 = 0

Idempotent: A + A = A, A · A = A

Inverse (Complement): A + A' = 1, A · A' = 0

De Morgan's Laws: (A + B)' = A' · B' (NOR), (A · B)' = A' + B' (NAND)

3. Logic Gates

  • AND: Y = A · B (1 only if A=1 and B=1)
  • OR: Y = A + B (0 only if A=0 and B=0)
  • NOT: Y = A' (Inverts input)
  • NAND: Y = (A · B)' (0 only if A=1 and B=1)
  • NOR: Y = (A + B)' (1 only if A=0 and B=0)
  • XOR: Y = A ⊕ B (1 if A ≠ B)
  • XNOR: Y = (A ⊕ B)' (1 if A = B)

4. Logic Minimization (Karnaugh Maps)

Grouping Rules: Group adjacent 1s in powers of 2. Groups can overlap and wrap around edges. Don't Cares (X) can be 1 or 0 to make the largest group.

Essential Prime Implicant: A group covering at least one '1' not covered by any other group.

5. Sequential Logic & Flip-Flops

  • D Flip-Flop: Q_next = D (Stores data at clock edge)
  • T Flip-Flop: Q_next = T ⊕ Q (Toggles if T=1, holds if T=0)
  • SR Flip-Flop: Q_next = S + R' · Q (S·R=0)
  • JK Flip-Flop: Q_next = J · Q' + K' · Q (J=K=1 toggles)

Setup/Hold Time: Setup (t_su) is minimum time data must be stable before edge. Hold (t_h) is after edge.

6. State Machine Design

Moore Machine: Outputs depend ONLY on current state.

Mealy Machine: Outputs depend on current state AND current inputs.
